chunks: "By God," said they, "you will never stop thinking of Joseph till you are consumed or perish."

key_terms.تَفْتَأُ: you will not cease / you will keep on

ai.seo_question: What did Jacob's sons say to him about his grief over Joseph?
ai.summary: The brothers' warning highlights the severity of Jacob’s prolonged grief, using the term 'harad' (consumption) to describe the physical wasting away caused by sorrow. In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the depth of the Patriarchs' emotional resilience and foreshadows the eventual reunion, illustrating how divine patience operates through human trials.
